v2-issue-1.title: Volume 2, Issue 1
headline: New team,
new look!
v2-issue-1.summary: ZX81 at 40, the Philips CD-i, The REAL Ghost Busters, Airwolf and a Psytronik pull-out poster.
v2-issue-1.intro: For the first time, Popular Retro is available in print. A massive retrospective of the Philips CD-i, everything you needed to know (and more!) about this obscure system, and the Sinclair ZX81 turns 40.
body: We have an exclusive interview with Kenz of Psytronik Software, and go old school with an A3 Psytronik pull-out poster! The team go Ghost Busting with classic toys, we look at low budget horror movies from the 80s and watch the paint peel in Retro in decay.
contents: ZX81: a computer for the masses
Win a THEC64 from Retro Games Ltd

editorNote.quote: A journey to our love of the 80s and 70s as we look at the early days of home computing, starting of course with the ZX81. A machine which has now turned 40!
body: The popular Great Moments in Computing cartoon, formerly published in Computer Shopper, finds a new home in Popular Retro. We talk to Psytronik Software in an exclusive interview, review the classic ZX Spectrum game Valley of Rains, and sink our teeth into the 1987 B-movie Evil Spawn.
Plus the chance to win a THEC64 computer from Retro Games Ltd.

v2-issue-1.contributors: Darren Randle (Editor), Darren Branagh, Shaun Bebbington, Luis Mota, Chris Thacker and Dr. Chris.

headline: Special
Edition #1
special-edition-1.summary: Collector's hardback with the best content from the first five issues, from THEC64 to ice lollies and Top Trumps.
special-edition-1.intro: Select cuts of issues one to four of Popular Retro plus issue five, in one beautiful hardback book.
body: This collector's hardback special of the much-loved magazine Popular Retro contains the best content from the first five issues. Extensively looking at THEC64, THEC64 Mini and THEVIC20 computers, it also contains exclusive interviews with legends of the gaming industry and features a wide range of articles about everything retro, from ice lollies to Top Trumps!

Whether you're a recent convert to classic gaming, an 8-bit fan from back in the day, or simply think that nostalgia's not what it used to be, this hardback will make a great addition to your bookshelf!
